palette: signal white + dispatch black + emerald route + ultramarine court + magenta sanction + yellow deadline
typography: compact transport sans with oversized day counters, route labels, thin deadline underlines, and outcome stamps
composition: filing tracks converge on deadline markers, extensions bridge all parties, late evidence enters a fault-sensitive switchyard, and investigation splits by institutional authority
surface: flat wayfinding bands, square dispatch stations, exposed route lines, and no card grid
motion: tracks draw left to right; one extension bridge expands across parties; evidence tokens branch only after fault and basic-fact checkpoints; court collection routes separate before their hearing outcomes
transition: a fixed bottom evidence rail carries the same document token through timing, delay, and investigation decisions
